subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app leaks orphaned SSH tunnel processes; PortGuardian never reaps them and they squat the preferred local port

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled macOS remote tunnel leak be fixed as a focused PortGuardian repair now, or coordinated with the related dashboard endpoint issue first?
rationale: The source-backed bug is clear, but the `maintainer` label pauses automation and the fix must preserve multiple live OpenClaw instances plus Docker/direct remote-mode listeners.

options.title: Focused PortGuardian repair
options.body: Add recorded-PID orphan cleanup with command and parent validation, then handle dashboard endpoint churn separately.

options.title: Coordinate with dashboard port fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until the stale-dashboard-port work is designed so tunnel cleanup and WebView endpoint refresh land together.

options.title: Wait for live macOS proof
options.body: Require a maintainer-run macOS reproduction before assigning a fix, accepting slower cleanup for a source-backed leak.

recommendation.title: Focused PortGuardian repair
recommendation.body: Add recorded-PID orphan cleanup with command and parent validation, then handle dashboard endpoint churn separately.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete merged the current tunnel implementation, co-authored the relevant PR, and opened this protected issue with live macOS evidence.
